verdict.rationale: IP India (CGPDTM) is a government intellectual-property office portal for e-filing, public search, status tracking and publications. It is not an AI agent or assistant that would act as an MCP client, so plugging in MCP servers to consume their tools is a category error for this product type. Nothing in the evidence shows any agentic or AI-assistant feature that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
